title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: your actual-to-penalties vs my hereditary vice
pass_a_gloss: So which sin does he mean? You will have Adam's actual imputed to all for two penalties—loss of original righteousness / original vice, and death. I say it is original vice or hereditary corruption inhering in each person, not Adam's actual immediately imputed to each. The reasons you brought do not prove your view: as you see, I have answered them.
pass_b_english: Let us see therefore which sin he understands. You will have it to be Adam's actual sin imputed to all humans unto two penalties, the privation of original righteousness or original vice, and death. I say it is original vice or hereditary corruption inhering in individual humans, but not Adam's actual sin immediately imputed to individual humans. Your opinion the reasons you brought do not prove: for to them, as you see, I have replied.
source_text: Videamus ergo quodnam peccatum intelligat. Tu vis esse peccatum actuale Adami imputatum omnibus hominibus ad duas poenas, privationem justitiae originalis seu vitium originale, & mortem. Ego dico esse vitium originale seu corruptionem haereditariam in singulis hominibus inhaerentem, non autem peccatum actuale Adami singulis hominibus immediate imputatum. Tuam sententiam, quas attulisti, rationes non probant: iis enim, ut vides, respondi.

choices.choice: Actual→two penalties vs inhering hereditary vice
